body_lead: Kerala transport minister announces no fine for child below 12 on bike with 2 adults caught on AI cameras Kerala has relaxed the rule that only two people can ride a two-wheeler. There has been a crackdown on traffic violations after 726 AI cameras were installed across Kerala in April. Kerala transport minister Antony Raj has agreed to allow a child below the age of 12 to sit on a bike with two adults without attracting fines. This will be in place until further notice from the Union government.
